outline:
為因應瞬息萬變的金融投資環境，培育學生具備宏觀的財務金融管理知識，本課程以深入淺出方式介紹財金之基本觀念及理論架構，並搭配資訊工具、財金個案分析、財務軟體、財金資料庫及財金資訊網站等應用，將財務金融的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的管理決策。課程架構包括：(1)財務金融基本原理；(2)財金資料庫的應用；(3)財務軟體的操作；(4)財金個案分析。透過本課程之學習，促使學生能制訂出正確且理性之財金管理決策。
In order to cope with the rapidly changing financial environment and cultivate students with macro financial management knowledge, this course introduces the basic concepts and theoretical framework of finance in a simple way, and is equipped with information tools, financial case analysis, financial software, and financial database and financial information websites and other applications, apply the concepts and principles of finance to important management decisions. The course framework includes: (1) Fundamental principles of finance; (2) Application of financial database; (3) Operation of financial software; (4) Financial case analysis. Through the study of this course, students will be able to make correct and rational financial management decisions.
schedule:
主題	課    程   進   度
一	 	公司目標與代理問題
二	 	金融市場架構與市場效率性
三	 	認識財務報表 & 財務報表分析
四	 	財務規劃與預測
五	     【財金個案研討與簡報】
assessment:
1.	出席參與 & 課堂問題研討：50%
2.	財金個案研討與簡報：50%
